capability.summary: Compute degree or betweenness centrality on an undirected graph
capability.description: Builds an unweighted undirected NetworkX Graph from a JSON edge list, then returns degree centrality when metric is exactly degree and betweenness centrality for every other metric value.
capability.problem_space: Basic node-centrality scoring and graph size reporting for a JSON-encoded undirected edge list.

constraint.io_signature: Inputs: JSON edge-list string and metric string; output: JSON with echoed metric, node and edge counts, and a node-to-centrality result map.
accepted_inputs: a JSON array of edge tuples accepted by NetworkX Graph.add_edges_from
metric value degree for degree centrality, or any other string to select betweenness centrality
constraint.output_shape: Success is an object with status="success", tool="lib.networkx_analyze", metric as the echoed selector string, nodes and edges as integer graph counts, and result as an object mapping node identifiers to numeric centrality scores. A caught edge-JSON, graph-construction, centrality, or serialization exception produces an object with status="error", tool="lib.networkx_analyze", and message as the exception string, then exits with code 1.
limitations: always constructs an undirected simple Graph, collapsing parallel edges and not preserving directed semantics
supports only degree centrality and betweenness centrality; it does not calculate paths despite the original broad label
any metric other than the exact string degree silently selects betweenness centrality instead of being rejected
the wrapper defaults a missing metric argument to degree even though the manifest declares it required
does not expose graph mutation, components, path queries, or configurable centrality parameters

output_contract.description: Graph size and node centrality scores for an undirected graph, using degree or betweenness selection.

json_schema.description: Native JSON representation only; no field or task-delivery guarantee.

intent_tags: compute node betweenness centrality from an edge list
negative_intents: find shortest paths between graph nodes
analyze directed or multigraph edge semantics
compute arbitrary NetworkX metrics by name
